## Checklist

### New term
- [ ] File is at `src/content/terms/your-term.md`
- [ ] All frontmatter fields are present (`title`, `tagline`, `primitives`, `category`, `publishedAt`)
- [ ] Tagline follows `"X is just Y with extra steps"` format
- [ ] `primitives` are real CS concepts — not other AI marketing terms
- [ ] All four sections present: **What they say** · **What it actually is** · **The "extra steps"** · **What you already know**
- [ ] At least one footnote citing a spec, Wikipedia, or official docs
- [ ] Code example in `snippet.code` is actual runnable pseudocode
- [ ] `draft: false` (or intentionally `true` if not ready)

### Correction to existing term
- [ ] The change improves factual accuracy (not tone/style preference)
- [ ] A source supporting the correction is cited

Closes #<!-- issue number if applicable -->
